jhaeld_1.m: What, who are you? Don't bother me, child. We don't want kids running around in here.
r: Are you Jhaeld? I was sent here to help you investigate the missing people.
Hey, watch that tone of yours. It would be a pity if more of your people would ... disappear.

jhaeld_10.m: OK, so what I would like you to do for me is ask some people what they know of the missing people. The fact that you are not from around here might help you get information that neither me nor my guards would be able to acquire.
r: Sure, I'll do it. Who do you want me to ask?
I'm not too sure about this. Will there be a reward?
I'm not too sure about this. Why would I want to help you people?

jhaeld_11.m: What, you have the arrogance to ask for a reward for helping us find the people that are missing? If it's gold you seek, I suggest you look somewhere else.
r: Fine, I'll do it. Who do you want me to ask?

jhaeld_12.m: I knew you were just trouble. Sigh. Please leave me.
r: Fine, I'll do it. Who do you want me to ask?

jhaeld_13.m: Why!? It would be the right thing to do, of course. If you can't understand that, you had better go somewhere else.
r: Fine, I'll do it. Who do you want me to ask?
I won't do it. I fail to see why I should help you.

jhaeld_14.m: There are four people here in Remgard that I believe have more to tell than what we have managed to get out of them. I want you to go ask them what they know of the disappearances.

jhaeld_15.m: First, there's Norath and his wife Bethir that lives in the farmhouse on the southwestern shore. Bethir is nowhere to be found, and Norath might know more about where she is.

jhaeld_16.m: Secondly, as you might have heard, we have been blessed by a visit from a delegation of the Knights of Elythom here in Remgard. Unfortunately, one of the knights has vanished, which is most embarrassing for us. They can be found here in the tavern.

jhaeld_17.m: Third, the old woman Duaina usually has great wisdom to share, considering the experience she has with ... things out of the ordinary. You'll find her in her house to the south.

jhaeld_18.m: Lastly, you should go talk to Rothses, the armorer in town. He meets most people now and then, and might have picked up something that he won't dare tell us guards. His house is on the western side of town.

jhaeld_19.m: Please be as swift as possible.
r: What about that Algangror woman that lives outside town?

jhaeld_2.m: Hrmpf. I don't take threats lightly. Especially not from snot-nosed kids like you.
r: I was sent here to help you investigate the missing people.
You better get used to it with an attitude like that.

jhaeld_20.m: As I said, please be as quick as possible.

jhaeld_21.m: What was that? Are you still here? I told you to be as quick as possible.
r: What about her? The bridge guard sent me to investigate that house, and seemed very upset when I mentioned that she's there.
I'll go ask those people you mentioned.

jhaeld_22.m: Did you not hear me? I told you to be as quick as possible! That means you should go talk to those people instead of standing around here blabbing.
r: I'll go ask those people you mentioned.

jhaeld_23.m: Are you still talking? I knew you were nothing but trouble the moment I saw you. Now, can you please hurry up and go talk to those people?

jhaeld_3.m: Yes, yes. The missing people. What could possibly a kid like you help with, hm?
r: I was thinking you could provide me with some tasks to help you with the investigation.
The bridge guard told me to talk to you.

jhaeld_4.m: Hmm, now that you are here you might as well make yourself useful instead of just standing there looking stupid. Even if you are a kid, you might be able to gather some information for me.
r: Sure, what do you need help with?
Hey, watch that tone of yours!

jhaeld_5.m: No, you watch that attitude of yours! Remember where you are and who you are talking to. I am Jhaeld, and you are in Remgard - which could be called *my* city.
r: Fine. What do you need help with?
You don't scare me, old man!

jhaeld_6.m: Ha ha. You? Killing something?! Now that's about the funniest thing I have heard all day. Just about.
r: Hey, watch that tone of yours!
I can handle myself. What do you need help with?

jhaeld_7.m: *sigh* To even think that we need to get help from children to run errands now.

jhaeld_8.m: I guess you know the background to this situation already. We have had some people disappear on us for some time now. We have no idea what has happened to the people that have disappeared, or even if they are still alive.

jhaeld_9.m: Considering how many there are that have disappeared without anyone knowing what happened, it doesn't seem like they are out travelling.

jhaeld_alg_1.m: Hmm, yes, and what of it?
r: I met a woman named Algangror in that house.

jhaeld_alg_10.m: So we forced her to explain herself.

jhaeld_alg_11.m: Would you believe it, she told us that what she believed in, and what she was doing was no concern of ours. She even had the stomach to tell us that she wanted to be left alone.

jhaeld_alg_12.m: Of course, we did what any sane man would do. We forced her to abandon her house and find somewhere else to live. Somewhere other than Remgard.

jhaeld_alg_13.m: You should have seen her. Nails long as your finger, and her face full of unwashed hair. Clearly, she was crazy and could not be reasoned with.

jhaeld_alg_14.m: When we marched her out of town, the children started crying out of fear of her.

jhaeld_alg_15.m: The worst thing though, is that she said she would put a curse on all of us.

jhaeld_alg_16.m: All of this was several seasons ago, and things have gone back to the usual business nowadays.
r: What now then, since she has returned?

jhaeld_alg_17.m: Yes. Her being back would explain the missing people. She must have done something to them. I fear for the worst.

jhaeld_alg_18.m: Considering the people that have disappeared, I frankly don't know what to do. As you know, even one of the Knights of Elythom has disappeared.

jhaeld_alg_19.m: Someone that can do that is dangerous indeed. I am not sure I would even risk sending the guards out there for her, in fear of what she might do.

jhaeld_alg_2.m: Algangror?! Now that's a name I have not heard in a long time.
r: Algangror is hiding in that abandoned house outside town.

jhaeld_alg_20.m: If I were to choose, I would rather not deal with it, and just seal the town bridge as safely as possible, to prevent any more people from disappearing.

jhaeld_alg_21.m: I ... I don't know what to do.
r: I could help you if you want.
You pathetic fool. You would rather sit here and do nothing instead of confronting her?

jhaeld_alg_21n.m: I ... I don't know what to do.

jhaeld_alg_22.m: I will not see more of my people get hurt, or whatever it is she has done to them. I will keep my people safe.
r: I could help you if you want.

jhaeld_alg_23.m: Insults won't get you anywhere. The people that have disappeared are still missing, and may be hurt, while you run around handing out insults. I pity you.
r: I could help you if you want.
You pathetic fool. You would rather sit here and do nothing instead of confronting her?

jhaeld_alg_24.m: If you really want to help us, then please be careful. She can not be trusted.

jhaeld_alg_25.m: However, if you were to find a way to make her disappear, we would of course be forever in your debt.
r: I'll see what I can do.
I have dealt with stronger foes.

jhaeld_alg_26.m: Remember, please be careful! I would not want to be responsible for another person disappearing.

jhaeld_alg_3.m: If Algangror is here, this is grim news indeed.

jhaeld_alg_4.m: To be honest, I had heard about this before, but I dismissed all talk of it since I did not believe it. Now you tell me this also, and I am starting to think that it may be true. She may have returned.

jhaeld_alg_5.m: She used to live here in Remgard, during the days of prosperity. She even helped with the crops on some days.

jhaeld_alg_6.m: Then something happened. She started getting ideas, and occasionally locked herself in her house for several days. No one really knew what she was doing in there, but we all knew that she was up to no good.

jhaeld_alg_7.m: I can still recall the stench that came from her house. Ugh. What could possibly smell that bad?

jhaeld_alg_8.m: Anyway, we started questioning her, and tried to persuade her to tell what she was up to. Stubborn and crazy as she is, she refused of course.

jhaeld_alg_9.m: Things started getting worse, and the stench spread like a deep fog over the whole town. All of us living here in Remgard knew we had to act before she did something that could hurt us all.

jhaeld_completed.m: Again, thank you for all your help.

jhaeld_idol_1.m: Please leave me be, child. I just had a sudden attack of nausea. I should probably lie down.

jhaeld_killalg.m: Hello again. What news do you bring?
r: Can you tell me the story of Algangror again?
I am still trying to find a way to make Algangror disappear.

jhaeld_killalg_1.m: I find this very hard to believe. For you to have killed Algangror would have been a difficult task, given her power.
r: I have brought you her ring as proof that what I say is true.
No, never mind. I haven't actually defeated her yet.

jhaeld_killalg_1b.m: I can hardly believe it! Yes, this is indeed her ring.

jhaeld_killalg_2.m: You actually defeated her? I am so relieved! Tell me, how crazy was she? No, don't tell me, I don't want to hear more of her filth.

jhaeld_killalg_3.m: This means that the people of Remgard are now safe from her, and it is all thanks to you! Who would have thought.

jhaeld_killalg_4.m: I ... I don't know what to say. Thank you, that's the least I can say.
r: That was a tough fight. Now, let's talk reward.

jhaeld_killalg_5.m: I would think that the whole town is in your debt, but they may not know it.

jhaeld_killalg_6.m: Go talk to Rothses over at the west side of town. He should be able to help you improve some of your equipment.

jhaeld_leave.m: I think you had better leave, before anything bad might happen to you.

jhaeld_rejected.m: What now? Look, we don't want kids like you running around here, messing with our things.

jhaeld_return1.m: Did you talk to those people that I sent you to ask about the missing people?
r: Yes, I have talked to all of them.
Can you repeat the names of those that you wanted me to ask?
I'm not too sure about this. Will there be a reward?
I'm not too sure about this. Why would I want to help you people?

jhaeld_return2.m: Well, what did you find out?
r: Nothing. None of them told me anything new about the missing people.

jhaeld_return3.m: So ... let me get things straight. You went and asked them about the missing people, and they didn't tell you anything new?
r: No. None of them had anything new to say.
You heard me the first time.
Maybe you should have sent me to ask other people than these losers you sent me to.

jhaeld_return4.m: Oh, I knew you were nothing but trouble the moment I saw you.

jhaeld_return5.m: I sent you to do a simple task, and you return with ... nothing!

jhaeld_return8.m: I suggest you go look in other places if you really want to help us.

jhaeld_task2.m: Maybe someone else knows something that we haven't taken into account yet.
r: The bridge guard sent me to scout an abandoned house outside town.
I might know something, but I have promised not to tell anyone.

jhaeld_task2_1.m: A secret, eh? You would do well to tell me what you know. Lives may be at stake here.
r: The bridge guard sent me to scout an abandoned house outside town.
No, I will keep my word and not tell.
Never mind, I'll go ask around if anyone else knows anything.

jhaeld_task2_2.m: Ah, someone with honor. I respect that, and will not ask any more.

jhaeld_task2_f.m: Maybe someone else knows something that we haven't taken into account yet. Also, I seem to recall you saying something about Algangror before, is that right?
r: Yes. As I tried to tell you, Algangror is hiding in that abandoned house outside town.

jhaeld_task2_n.m: I have nothing more to say to you.

jhaeld_task2_y.m: Maybe someone else knows something that we haven't taken into account yet.
r: The bridge guard sent me to scout an abandoned house outside town.
Does the name 'Algangror' mean anything to you?

remgard2.10: I have told Jhaeld, the village elder in Remgard, about the woman named Algangror that lives in the abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake outside Remgard.
remgard2.20: Jhaeld told me that he would rather not deal with her, since he believes she is very dangerous. For the sake of his guards, he will not risk going against her since he is afraid of what might happen to all of them.
remgard2.21: If I want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should find a way to make Algangror disappear. He also warns me to be extremely careful.
remgard2.30: Algangror admitted to me that she had made some people disappear from Remgard. She would not tell me what happened to them though.
remgard2.35: I have started attacking Algangror. I should return to Jhaeld with proof of defeating her when she is dead.
remgard2.40: I have told Jhaeld that I defeated Algangror.
remgard2.41: Jhaeld was very pleased to hear the good news. The people of Remgard should now be safe, and the town can be opened to outsiders again.
remgard2.45: For helping the people of Remgard find the cause of the disappearing people, Jhaeld told me to talk to Rothses. He might be able to improve some of my equipment.
remgard2.46: Ervelyn, the Remgard tailor, gave me a feathered hat as thanks for helping the people of Remgard find out what happened to the missing people.

fiveidols.10: Algangror wants me to help her with a task. She cannot describe the nature of the task, or the reasoning behind it. If I help her, she has promised to give me her enchanted necklace, that apparently is worth a lot.
fiveidols.20: I have agreed to help Algangror with her task.
fiveidols.30: Algangror wants me to place five idols near five different people in Remgard. The idols should be placed near the beds of these five people, and must be hidden so that they are not found easily.
fiveidols.31: The first person is Jhaeld, the village elder that can be found in the Remgard tavern.
fiveidols.32: Second, I should place an idol by the bed of Larni the farmer, that lives in one of the northern cabins in Remgard.
fiveidols.33: The third person is Arnal the weapon-smith, that lives in the northwest of Remgard.
fiveidols.34: Fourth is Emerei, that can be found to the southeast of Remgard.
fiveidols.35: The fifth person is Carthe. Carthe lives on the eastern shore of Remgard, near the tavern.
fiveidols.37: I must not tell anyone of my task, or of the placement of the idols.
fiveidols.41: I have placed an idol by Jhaeld's bed.
fiveidols.42: I have placed an idol by Larni the farmer's bed.
fiveidols.43: I have placed an idol by Arnal's bed.
fiveidols.44: I have placed an idol by Emerei's bed.
fiveidols.45: I have placed an idol by Carthe's bed.
fiveidols.50: All the idols have been placed by the beds of the people that Algangror told me to visit. I should return to Algangror.
fiveidols.51: Algangror thanked me for helping her.
fiveidols.60: She told me her story, with how she used to live in the city, but was persecuted for her beliefs. According to her, the persecution was totally unjustified since she does no harm to people.
fiveidols.61: To take revenge on the city of Remgard, she managed to lure some people into her cabin and turn them into rats.
fiveidols.70: For helping her with the tasks that she could not perform herself, Algangror gave me her enchanted necklace, 'Marrowtaint'.
fiveidols.100: I have decided not to help Algangror with her task.

remgard.10: I have reached the bridge to enter the town of Remgard. According to the bridge guard, the town is closed for outsiders to enter, and no-one is currently allowed to leave. They are investigating some disappearances of some of the townspeople.
remgard.15: I have offered my assistance in helping the people of Remgard investigate what has happened to the townspeople that have disappeared.
remgard.20: The bridge guard has asked me to investigate an abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake. I should be wary of any inhabitants that may be there.
remgard.30: I have reported back to the bridge guard that I met Algangror in the abandoned house.
remgard.31: I have reported back to the bridge guard that the abandoned house was empty.
remgard.35: I have been granted entrance into Remgard. I should go visit Jhaeld, the town elder, to talk about what the next step should be. Jhaeld can probably be found in the tavern to the southeast.
remgard.40: Jhaeld was rather arrogant, but told me that they have had a problem with people disappearing for a while now. They have no clue what could be causing it.
remgard.50: I should visit four people in Remgard, and ask them about any clues on what might have happened to the missing people.
remgard.51: First is Norath, whose wife Bethir has disappeared. Norath can be found in the south-westernmost farmhouse.
remgard.52: Second, I should go talk to the Knights of Elythom, here in the tavern.
remgard.53: Third, I should go talk to the old woman Duaina in her house to the south.
remgard.54: Lastly, I should talk to Rothses, the armorer. He lives on the west side of town.
remgard.59: I tried to tell Jhaeld about Algangror, but he dismissed me as he had not heard me.
remgard.61: I have talked to Norath. He and his wife had been fighting recently, but he has no idea on what may have happened to her.
remgard.62: The Knights of Elythom in the Remgard tavern have had one of their knights disappearing recently. No one noticed anything when she disappeared, however.
remgard.63: Duaina has seen me in her visions. I did not understand all that she spoke of, but the parts that were clear were that me and Andor were parts of a larger plot. I wonder what this means? She did not speak of any disappearing people however, not that I could understand anyway.
remgard.64: Rothses told me that Bethir visited him the night before she disappeared, to sell some equipment. He did not see where she went after that.
remgard.70: I have talked to all of the people that Jhaeld wanted me to talk to, but did not get any information from any of them about what may have happened to the missing people. I should go back to Jhaeld and ask what his plans are next.
remgard.75: Jhaeld was really upset that I did not find out anything from the people that I was sent to talk to.
remgard.80: If I still want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should look for clues in other places.
remgard.110: Jhaeld does not want to talk to me. I will not help them find out what happened to the missing people of Remgard.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
